answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 164537 Country: India Title: Can I keep ‘Ada’ as a girl name? Question: Can I keep ‘Ada’ as a girl name? Answer ID: 164537 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1345/1120/N=12/1439) Yes, you may keep the name of your daughter as Ada. Ada means payment, performance etc. (Al-Qamus al-Wahid, p. 116) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
